description: DWR Dam Safety Active Design Review is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. This list provides a summary of proposed projects to build new dams, enlarge existing dams, or perform maintenance/repair projects at existing dams. It contains projects that are currently under review and projects that have been approved or rejected within the last 45 days. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Water. Its tags are active design review, construction, dam safety, reservoir. The table has 32 columns. Attribution on the portal: DNR - Division of Water Resources. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
